decisions.reason: The candidate's same-message INTRODUCE already records the category label's placement with the article title and its visually appealing presentation; the source MODIFY only adds the relative placement of author attribution.
Placement of the author name and photo after the title and category label does not change the requirement to improve article-image quality when necessary.
The author-attribution placement decision does not change where magazine articles must be sourced.
The source decision concerns article metadata placement and does not alter the policy reserving red for the cover.
The article author-attribution placement does not change the deferred print-output format, resolution, trim, or bleed requirements.
Although the label and attribution should be visually appealing, the source does not modify the existing magazine-wide polished, modern, brand-aligned style requirement.
The placement of author attribution within article layouts does not change the required digital flipbook deliverable.
The source specifies placement for the separate author-attribution requirement and does not change the magazine's general layout inputs, compilation action, or Flat Plan arrangement basis.
